What is aether?

Aether analyzes a wallpaper's colors (using a median-cut palette algorithm with several extraction modes and fine-tuning sliders) and generates a cohesive 16-color theme from it, then applies that theme across 20+ apps like Hyprland, Kitty, Alacritty, VS Code, and Neovim. It also bundles a wallpaper browser/downloader for wallhaven.cc, an image editor with filters, and a library of built-in presets (Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox, Catppuccin) plus 250+ importable Base16 community schemes.

Install aether on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add aether

Good to know

  • No special requirements documented.
